walkthroughs.title: AI design to a signed project
walkthroughs.lede: A homeowner's photos and real dimensions become AI mockups with real plants, a to-scale plan, an estimate, a Good/Better/Best proposal, a signed approval with deposit, and the agents' follow-up work.

walkthroughs.title: Small and recurring jobs
walkthroughs.lede: Weekly grass cutting from an instant quote or a 2-minute Quick Quote to a season of visits, a route, a rain day, the crew's visit, a Spot-it upsell, autopay, renewal and route profitability.

walkthroughs.title: A crew's day in the field app
walkthroughs.lede: Shared-tablet sign-in and crew punch, DVIR and tailgate talk, load-out, the route, mowing and fertilizer visits with the wind gate, a dead zone and sync, an install with plant records, field payments, close-out and a Snow Lite storm visit.

walkthroughs.title: Invoicing, payments and the books
walkthroughs.lede: A month-end billing run, client payments into the Company's own Stripe account, a failed autopay and a dispute, payout reconciliation, bank feeds, bills, job costing, deferred revenue, close and statements, and optional QuickBooks sync.

walkthroughs.title: Commercial and HOA accounts
walkthroughs.lede: An RFP parsed into a scope matrix, a per-month commercial estimate, board approvals by quorum, site maps and inspections, enhancements, snow, consolidated billing, portfolio reporting and renewal.

walkthroughs.title: The owner's day with AI agents
walkthroughs.lede: The daily briefing, one Approval Inbox for every agent, inbox triage with prompt-injection defense, Copilot answers and actions, an automation built from a sentence, marketing, reports and benchmarks, and AI credit controls.

walkthroughs.title: Getting started and the operator console
walkthroughs.lede: A company switching from Jobber and QuickBooks signs up, connects its own Stripe account, imports its data and sends a first quote; then the platform owner runs tenants, consented support, plant curation, AI operations and SaaS billing.

walkthroughs.title: Hiring and seasonal crews
walkthroughs.lede: A Spanish job post and mobile apply for the spring rush, onboarding through the payroll partner, credentials enforced at dispatch, bilingual training, the H-2B workspace, time off and payroll export.

walkthroughs.title: Purchasing, inventory, fleet and subcontractors
walkthroughs.lede: Buy lists from sold jobs become consolidated POs with nursery availability, deliveries and receiving, inventory modes and counts, preventive maintenance and equipment cost per hour, and the subcontractor compliance gate and portal.

walkthroughs.title: Irrigation, lighting and other service lines
walkthroughs.lede: Irrigation start-ups, backflow tests and winterization with smart controllers, landscape and holiday lighting, mosquito programs, install projects with dig tickets and punch lists, and tree care as a later module.

walkthroughs.title: Design Studio in depth
walkthroughs.lede: From parcel and aerial to a to-scale plan: drawing tools, hardscape with base specs, irrigation and lighting layers, sun study, 3D with growth and seasons, options and versions, client markup, and a plan-set PDF.

walkthroughs.title: Getting found: website, quotes and reviews
walkthroughs.lede: A Rootline-built website with a project gallery and plant pages, public instant quotes and booking, the homeowner visualizer embed, review and referral loops, neighborhood campaigns and the AI receptionist.

walkthroughs.title: The future: moonshots
walkthroughs.lede: Clearly labeled V2 and V3 bets: the property's living record that transfers at home sale, AR on site, robotic mower fleets, smart irrigation with soil sensors, plant health AI, sustainability reports and embedded financing.
